review_role: Independent native Codex subagent; no evaluated model response, scorer body, generator fragment or target execution consulted

scope.freshness: new task-content exposure per collection record; filenames previously listed; no pretrained novelty claim
scope.reference: AI-assisted researcher reference, not real human annotation

checks.check: Exact six description templates and placeholder notes form the shared input boundary
Generic schema enumerates broad answer kinds, not the six task-specific semantic solutions
Prompt preserves semantic type versus explicit syntax distinction and does not invent absent reward/normalization policy
Reference contracts and per-task comparison rubric independently reviewed against descriptions before evaluated model responses
Each reference object validates and evidence quotes are exact description substrings
Six fresh ephemeral one-shot requests, isolated temporary working directories, user config/project docs disabled, no accepted tool-action events
checks.qualification: Runtime event audit and exact request count must still be checked on actual runs; code alone does not prove no network request retries inside the CLI.

checks.check: No scorer, reference contract, filenames, issue/repair status or comparison rubric included in request payload
Response/schema/ID/evidence validation fail closed and preserve failed attempts; outputs cannot silently overwrite
Frozen prior baseline integrity check is present and independently passes
Downstream design admits only existing canonical True/False necessary-condition projection; other task kinds stay Unknown
checks.qualification: This audit reviews design only, not final bridge/source preparation or downstream outcomes.

checks.check: Revision groups and denominator 60 fixed; semantic equivalence rather than natural-language exact string equality; no genuine human-time/savings claim
No blanket negative labels from no findings; no fabricated extra real bug cases; stop after six-task pilot

resolved_findings.finding: Python float NaN/Infinity passed the first numeric validator although JSON Schema numbers are finite
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added math.isfinite rejection and synthetic NaN/+Infinity/-Infinity regression before extraction freeze; independently reran passing suite.

resolved_findings.finding: Per-task comparison rubric in reference/annotation-notes.md was initially outside extraction_files
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added rubric file to extraction freeze before model requests.

limits: Both reference author and reviewer are AI assistants; same ecosystem/model biases can correlate. Reference is not an independently collected human gold standard.
Field revisions are a descriptive review-burden proxy; no causal reduction of human annotation cost or actual time savings can be inferred.
Six purposively selected templates in one project are not a random benchmark or independent task-instance sample.
No pretrained-model contamination/novelty claim is established.
Exact model/default decoding identity may be unavailable from the CLI; record actual metadata and qualify this rather than invent it.
The fixed Boolean projection checks scorer agreement with trusted reference strings, not correctness of the underlying task solver, full formatting, or non-Boolean contracts.
Model outputs, source preparation, final bridge and downstream labels/results remain to be audited after the pre-model freeze.
